summary: Nuvectis Pharma filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, reporting entry into an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC as sales agent for a new at-the-market common stock program, alongside a new $200 million Form S-3 shelf, replacing the prior ATM terminated July 20, 2026. Jefferies receives up to 3.0% gross commission, selling on commercially reasonable efforts with no escrow and no minimum. No board recommendation or advisor beyond Jefferies is cited. This is an ordinary shelf takedown and financing facility, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and share overhang.
